notes.issue: The conda shell wrapper did not launch correctly on this host.
notes.resolution: Invoked the same conda manager through base Python with python -m conda; no pip installation.

notes.issue: The legacy official download hostname stalled; the current official hostname had low single-connection throughput.
notes.resolution: Downloaded non-overlapping byte ranges from cave.cs.toronto.edu and verified the assembled archive against the official MD5. Source data was not changed.

notes.issue: Initial test run: 9 tests passed; the sealed-test guard test hit a Windows sandbox permission error while cleaning an unnecessary temporary directory.
notes.resolution: Use a verified non-existing relative path for the sealed-test guard. No file creation/deletion is needed to test the pre-load rejection. The assertion remains unchanged. Formal training had not started.

notes.issue: Grad-CAM metadata initially reused target for two meanings.
notes.resolution: Separated official target from explained_class; verified all four explained classes equal predictions. Heatmap computation and trained models were unchanged.

notes.issue: Highest-confidence errors exposed possible semantic label issues.
notes.resolution: Independently decoded all 10000 test images and labels with torchvision. No mismatch found; kept official labels and original score.

notes.issue: The initial PDF used reader-dependent CJK font substitution.
notes.resolution: Embedded a Microsoft YaHei subset and re-rendered/reviewed all seven pages; no font warnings in final render.

notes.issue: Preliminary environment comparison did not validate the reference prefix existed.
notes.resolution: Added conda-meta/Python existence checks and reran the final audit against the actual original environment after report acceptance.

notes.issue: Git auto-normalization would change CRLF evidence bytes and break stored SHA256 links after cloning.
notes.resolution: Marked hashed text evidence as -text while keeping Python source eol=lf; verify staged and freshly checked-out bytes before publication. Training source, model states and measured results are unchanged.
